selector-class-pattern.message: Class names are whole lowercase words joined by hyphens, each at least three letters (for example hill-green, not hg or shape-7). Google: Class Naming, Class Name Delimiters. css-art: three-letter minimum.

custom-property-pattern.message: Custom property names are whole lowercase words joined by hyphens, each at least three letters. css-art rule.

keyframes-name-pattern.message: Animation names are whole lowercase words joined by hyphens, each at least three letters. css-art rule.

selector-max-id.message: Avoid ID selectors; use a class. Google: ID Selectors.

selector-no-qualifying-type.message: Do not qualify a class with an element name. Google: Type Selectors.

declaration-no-important.message: Avoid !important; use specificity. Google: Important Declarations.
